procedure.method: Fresh independent craft review. Read the exact pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, compact method/addendum, adapter and five image source manifests; verified the declared input byte pins and PNG dimensions without following unlisted embedded paths. The packet has no supplied source assets and no protected-layout manifests, so no source-image opens or protected-layout reads apply. Actually opened and visually inspected the fifteen exact poster files using tools.view_image with detail='original', emitting each returned image with original detail in five sequential functions.exec calls. Within each call the native, usage720 and thumbnail320 opens were sequential; member order was M1, M2, M3, M4, M5. All fifteen displayed views were completed before the first copy-reading/transcription stage or any judgment/score. First raw copy readings below were read from the displayed native pixels, with layout and practical legibility checked against the already displayed usage views; no OCR, asset substitution, new images or ambiguity-triggered reopens were used. Viewed receipts attest these actual opens, not a helper exit or filename. All five native views are 1672x941; 941-(1672*9/16)=0.5 pixel, so ratio PASS uses the predeclared nearest-integer-single-edge policy, not mathematical equality. Usage views are 720x405 and thumbnail views 320x180. Session identity is unobservable here and remains null.
